topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: That former student of mine, deciding now, out of the blue, to send something. What took them so long to think of me? Not like I've been sitting around, waiting. I had a whole life outside those classroom walls. And now, this? A box showing up like it's carrying all the answers, like it can make up for lost time. Well, it doesn’t. I didn’t ask for this nostalgia. I didn’t need it. But here it is, pushing its way into my space, making me confront shadows of the past. I’ll deal with it, but it doesn’t change a thing.
